# Temporary workspace

- For temporary files and scratch work, use `R:\canman_react_temp`.
- Keep Canman temporary data below the 6 GB limit. Check existing use and
  available space before staging large batches; do not exceed the limit.
- Remove only temporary files created for the current task when finished.
- Keep deliverables, source files, and safety backups in their normal project
  locations, not on the RAM drive.
- If `R:\` is unavailable or the temporary-space limit would be exceeded, stop
  and ask before using another drive.
- Prefer `CANMAN_TEMP_DIR` for scripts that support a configurable temp root.
